purpose: PR12 engine handoff and NVCompact generalization research; upstream methods retained regardless of Rove4k adoption
method: Public git histories cloned with --no-checkout outside the Rove4k repository; selected actual diffs read. No engine/bootstrap/ELF loader/build script execution or new compression measurement.
candidate_search: Keyword scan over all reachable non-merge refs plus manual follow-up for related changes; selected_diffs_reviewed includes some non-keyword follow-ups. This is not every historical commit or formal semantic verification.

classification.P: 의미 보존 후보: 이 diff의 사용 문맥을 벗어나 자동 적용하려면 별도 증명이 필요함
classification.M: 알고리즘/검색 순서/평가/타이밍 또는 계약 변화가 섞인 수정
classification.B: 빌드·압축·패키징 후보: 대상 ABI와 실행 환경 검증 필요
classification.F: 기능이나 관찰 가능한 출력을 제거하는 특수화
classification.D: 기록 또는 설계 실험: 엔진 변경으로 착각하면 안 됨

limitations: All byte savings are upstream title/README/source-comment/ledger claims, never new measurements. Mixed commits cannot attribute total gain to a single sub-change. Do not add deltas across revisions.
c4ke and STRO4K histories include multiple branches; cherry-picked equivalents are not independent experiments. The selected SHA is the precise evidence reference.

STRO4K public history/branches do not establish correspondence to every current TCEC roster label, including version 6.0; 2026 Sunfish NNUE experiments are not automatically the historical classic submission.
Pytteliten explicitly targets TCEC4K in upstream README, but actual participation was not confirmed in the existing Rove4k event roster; it is an adjacent reference.

Moonfish means zamfofex/moonfish only. Public sourcehut and current neocities script were inaccessible through this session web tool. Prior metadata records sourcehut 404 and unresolved historical/current equivalence. No Moonfish commit delta is claimed.
The initially fetched github.com/mateoxh/molly is an unrelated namesake and is excluded. The reviewed TCEC molly is codeberg.org/latuernich/molly.

Certain large commits were reviewed through selected file/hunk diffs; each record states that scope. This catalogue is evidence for design candidates, not a full security/correctness audit of any upstream minifier.
No external engine source is intended to enter Rove4k; only citations and analysis from this review should be integrated.
